{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, stripping commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]

# Filter to converted customers
converted_customers = sales[sales['converted'] == 1]

# Check if QA orders were marked as converted
qa_converted = qa_orders[qa_orders['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude QA orders from the converted group
converted_customers_clean = converted_customers[~converted_customers.index.isin(qa_orders.index)]

# Exclude -1 values in customer_age (sentinel for missing)
converted_customers_clean_with_age = converted_customers_clean[converted_customers_clean['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age of valid converted customers
mean_age_converted = converted_customers_clean_with_age['customer_age'].mean()

# Final numbers
n_converted_total = len(converted_customers)
n_converted_clean = len(converted_customers_clean)
n_converted_with_age = len(converted_customers_clean_with_age)

print(f"Total converted customers (including QA): {n_converted_total}")
print(f"Converted customers after removing QA orders: {n_converted_clean}")
print(f"Converted customers with valid age: {n_converted_with_age}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding QA and -1): {mean_age_converted:.2f} years")"}
